description: Look a company up on its public register (Companies House for GB, ABN Lookup for AU) by its registered number. Returns the full public record: name, status, registered office, officers, SIC codes, accounting period, plus both filing deadlines with days remaining and the late-filing penalty already incurred if overdue. Rate limited and quota-charged; cached results are free. Find the number first with search_companies.

companyNumber.description: The register identifier: GB company number (e.g. 15379140) or AU ABN.

jurisdiction.description: ISO country code. Register access exists for GB and AU.

name: lookup_company
